title: Fault Telemetry Consolidator and Stratified Error Explorer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidate error telemetry across tracing, metrics, and logs into a single structured schema and build a dashboard that exposes stratified error slices. The goal is to make it trivial for oncall and platform engineers to pivot from a high-level symptom (increased latency or error rate) to precise causal slices: transport errors (HTTP/gRPC codes), resource pressure (queue depth/backpressure), model-level failures (generation errors, bad tokenizer, OOM), and platform timeouts. Deliverables: (1) Span/metric/log enrichment spec, (2) ingestion pipeline transforms and mappings, (3) a Stratifed Error Explorer dashboard with drilldowns and sampling controls, and (4) rollout plan with sampling ramp and SLO impact analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Schema: All request traces include standardized fields: fault.category, fault.code, fault.phase, model.variant, node.cpu/mem_snapshot, queue_length at span root
Pipeline: Enrichment transformer deployed to staging that adds fault.* tags for 100% of sampled traces and backfills 7 days of derived metrics in OLAP
Dashboard: Stratifed Error Explorer shows top 10 error slices by p95 latency, p99 latency, and error-rate with ability to filter by model, region, capacity tier
Tracing hooks: SDK patch merged that annotates spans with upstream HTTP/gRPC codes and normalized model errors (e.g., generation_failure, tokenization_error, kv_cache_miss)
SLO impact: Automated SLO dashboard updates surface which slices drive alerts and include runbook links
Rollout: Sampling ramp plan validated (stage: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with fallback toggle and no more than 2% cost variance in staging
tasks: Design telemetry schema and naming conventions with product and SRE
Implement trace hook in runtime SDK to capture transport codes and model error enums
Add transformers in metrics/log pipeline: derive fault.category and map HTTP/gRPC codes to categories
Create OLAP materialized views for error slices (by model, route, region, capacity tier)
Build Stratifed Error Explorer dashboard in Console with drilldown and time-travel
Create runbooks and annotate dashboard slices with suggested remediation steps
Roll out to staging and run smoke tests with synthetic error injection
Monitor cost and ingestion rates; iterate sampling policy

notes: We must avoid over-attributing failures to models when underlying cause is preemptive timeouts upstream. Add confidence score to each derived fault to indicate heuristics used.
Consider exporting the error slices to a weekly report for product and infra leadership after MVP rollout.
Plan a follow-up ticket to add anomaly-detection alerts per error slice once the OLAP materialized views are stable.
